mapper.select: SELECT settlement_id, expo_id, expo_title, event_end_at, settlement_due_at, status, gross_ticket_sales_amount, ticket_refund_amount, net_ticket_sales_amount, booking_fee_gross_amount, booking_fee_refund_amount, booking_fee_net_amount, gross_booth_sales_amount, adjustment_amount, remittance_due_amount, remitted_amount, remitted_at, remittance_status, latest_report_file_id, latest_report_format, latest_report_version FROM v_client_dashboard_settlements WHERE host_client_id = #{hostClientId} ORDER BY settlement_due_at, settlement_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM v_client_dashboard_settlements WHERE host_client_id = #{hostClientId}

SELECT settlement_id, expo_id, expo_title, event_end_at, settlement_due_at, status, gross_ticket_sales_amount, ticket_refund_amount, net_ticket_sales_amount, booking_fee_gross_amount, booking_fee_refund_amount, booking_fee_net_amount, gross_booth_sales_amount, adjustment_amount, remittance_due_amount, remitted_amount, remitted_at, remittance_status, latest_report_file_id, latest_report_format, latest_report_version FROM v_client_dashboard_settlements WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND host_client_id = #{hostClientId}
SELECT item_type, amount, included_in_remittance, occurred_at FROM settlement_items WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} ORDER BY id

SELECT settlement_id, status, expo_id, expo_title, event_end_at, host_client_id, company_name, settlement_due_at, remittance_due_amount, adjustment_amount, confirmed_at, confirmed_by, remitted_amount, remitted_at, remittance_status FROM v_admin_settlement_status
ORDER BY settlement_due_at, settlement_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
